## Checklist

- [ ] The PR is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] No existing failing test was deleted or weakened.
- [ ] Module paths, original copyright and licenses are preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, real subscriber data, full config or raw captures are included.
- [ ] Test success is not presented as device, kernel or carrier certification.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior and remaining limits.
